summary: Qualified homeowner hesitated; agent pushed instead of offering callback or tentative hold.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Alex with Summit Home Services. I can help schedule a free HVAC inspection.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm interested but I need to talk to my spouse first.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Are you the homeowner in Denver metro?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great. Let's just book now and you can change it later if needed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Slots fill up fast. If you don't book today you might wait weeks.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That feels pushy. I'll call back.
